timecoded_text_to_speech.text: The solar system is in constant motion, with the sun hurtling through space at 828,000 km per hour,
dragging its retinue of planets, asteroids and comets. Earth rotates at about 1,670 km per hour
and orbits the sun at 108,000 km per hour. This complex dance is shaped by gravitational forces,
each celestial body influencing the others in an intricate cosmic ballet, revealing the true
dynamism of our corner of the universe.
